name: Alpha Partner USDA
oneLiner: USDA is Alpha Partners' BSC-only dollar token whose backing is described only as protocol-managed collateral and liquidity reserves; mechanism opaque.
collateral: Undisclosed and unverified. AP Web3 / Alpha Partners markets USDA as 1:1 USD-backed by reserves with 'FDIC protection', but publishes no reserve composition, proof of reserves, or attestation; the FDIC claim is unsubstantiated (FDIC does not insure stablecoins). Backing is opaque.
pegMechanism: Undocumented. The issuer publishes no mint/redeem or peg-maintenance mechanism. On-chain USDA is a BSC ERC-20 with a role-gated mint, an address blacklist, and modifiable transfer tax/fees; no peg-stabilization process is described.

reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28 of both primary issuer surfaces confirms continued absence of any USDA reserve composition. (1) https://alphapartner.vip/ returned HTTP 200 as an AP U-Card marketing page; HTML and the shipped index JS contain multi-chain stablecoin/USDT top-up copy only and zero mentions of USDA, reserve composition, proof of reserves, attestation, FDIC, or itemized backing assets. Paths such as /transparency, /reserve, /reserves, and /usda serve the same SPA shell with no additional disclosure. (2) The full Alpha Partners GitBook corpus (llms.txt index plus every linked .md page: background, overview, settlement, multi-card, KYC, core features, usage guidelines, rules-and-trust, vision, roadmap, FAQ, contact, and strategy subpages) was re-fetched; none of the pages name USDA, publish reserve assets/weights/custodians/balances, or host an attestation or proof-of-reserves report—only U-Card USDT top-up flows and generic platform risk language. Secondary aggregator marketing (e.g. CoinGecko/DefiLlama 1:1 USD/FDIC phrasing) is not issuer primary disclosure and supplies no itemized composition; DefiLlama auditLinks remains null. Composition therefore remains a single 100% undisclosed-reserve bucket with knownUnknownExposurePct=100.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: No primary USDA reserve-composition disclosure found in the re-opened issuer website and full GitBook corpus on 2026-07-28
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All reserve asset identities, weights, obligors, custodians, legal safeguards, liquidity terms, valuation methods, and asset-versus-liability reconciliation remain unknown.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Re-opened official website and full GitBook corpus on 2026-07-28 still publish no USDA reserve source from which a composition could be authored.

mintAuthority.summary: USDA's BSC token has an uncapped MINT role. At BSC block 112274230, the MINT role is held by a minter contract and an EOA; the EOA is the sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder and can appoint more minters. The minter contract's owner is a separate EOA that can authorize callers through that contract. Address ownership, custody, and any non-standard replacement or migration authority are undisclosed.

controls.label: USDA MINT role holder — BSC minter contract
controls.capDescription: USDA has no maximum-supply check; this MINT-role contract can call the token's mint path without an on-chain amount cap.

sources.label: USDA MINT grant to minter contract

controls.evidence: The verified USDA source defines MINT as keccak256('MINT') and restricts mint(address,uint256) to that role with no maximum-supply condition. The BSC receipt at block 56765548 records RoleGranted(MINT, 0x56f237297306220ebc062b7c0348418c9cdccbdb, 0xc2eff14db94094486a07c791362a6c4176d3c5f7); hasRole(MINT, 0x56f237297306220ebc062b7c0348418c9cdccbdb) returned true at block 112274230. This 4,314-byte contract is source-unverified, so its modules and downstream policy are not asserted.

controls.label: USDA MINT and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder — BSC
controls.capDescription: USDA has no maximum-supply check; this EOA can mint directly and, as DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, can grant or revoke MINT.

sources.label: USDA MINT self-grant by current administrator

controls.evidence: At block 88662302 the former administrator granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to this address; at block 88662792 this address granted itself MINT. At block 112274230, hasRole(MINT, address) and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, address) both returned true, getRoleAdmin(MINT) returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and eth_getCode returned empty bytecode. No public source identifies the key owner, custody arrangement, or threshold.

controls.label: USDA MINT-role minter-contract owner — BSC
controls.capDescription: USDA has no maximum-supply check; this EOA owns the MINT-role minter contract and can authorize callers through its expand-minter path, but does not itself hold USDA MINT or DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE at the observed block.
controls.evidence: At block 112274230, owner() on the source-unverified MINT-role minter contract returned this empty-code address. Its pinned bytecode restricts the expand-minter update path to owner and its current mapping authorizes a caller that can successfully simulate dynamicRewardsMint through the MINT-role contract. USDA hasRole(MINT, address) and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, address) both returned false at the same block. No custody or threshold is disclosed.

review.evidence: Re-reviewed mint roles 2026-07-26 at BSC block 112274230; upgrade-authority follow-up 2026-07-28 at BSC block 112516717 (block hash 0xbf16acf314e97d9600a2d69586b86b8a0e018351754e8b623d4cc9ebe68e1e29) via fixed-block BSC RPC. The verified USDA source (contract USDAWithPremium, BscScan exact match; Sourcify full_match runtime+creation) defines MINT as keccak256('MINT') / 0xfdf81848136595c31bb5f76217767372bc4bf906663038eb38381131ea27ecba, gates mint(address,uint256) with onlyVault (hasRole MINT) and no maximum-supply check, and sets DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE as MINT's admin. Fixed-block hasRole still confirms MINT for 0x56f237297306220ebc062b7c0348418c9cdccbdb and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE for 0x14170c3332ccd96859c8fb5754a753e476d09751. Upgradeability resolution: (1) creation tx 0x2af6b226… has empty to and deploys contractAddress 0x17eafd08… at block 56765216 (direct CREATE, not a proxy factory call); (2) at block 112516717 EIP-1967 implementation/admin/beacon slots on the token are all zero and runtime code is 17,338 bytes; (3) verified source and ABI contain mint/AccessControl/tax/blacklist surfaces but no upgradeTo, upgradeToAndCall, proxiableUUID, implementation, diamondCut, beacon, or delegatecall upgrade path; (4) independent Sourcify proxyResolution reports isProxy=false with empty implementations. Therefore mint-critical token bytecode is non-upgradeable (model=immutable, canChangeMintLogic=false). DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can still grant MINT to new callers; that is authority concentration, not implementation upgrade. The MINT-role minter contract 0x56f237… remains source-unverified (4,314 bytes) with zero EIP-1967 slots, but does not host the token mint implementation. No reserve reconciliation or named prudential supervisor is evidenced.
